description: Tired of static KPI visuals in Power BI? Native card visuals display numbers, but they don't explain what's changing, why it's changing, or how KPIs relate. Zebra BI Cards transforms KPI reporting into interactive, actionable scorecards. With one visual, you can show multiple KPIs, add comparisons and sparklines, and drill into details, all while keeping dashboards clean, fast, and consistent. Why do 3,000+ companies choose Zebra BI Cards? One visual, multiple KPIs – faster performance, cleaner dashboards, and better visibility across metrics. Clarity at-a-glance – show variances, comparisons, and trendlines in one KPI card. Scorecards & layouts – create multi-card KPI dashboards with flexible layouts (rows, columns, sparklines). Interactivity built-in – drill-through, focus mode, chart slider, invert options. Flexible scaling – scale different KPI cards consistently or independently to ensure the right context and comparability across metrics. Custom design control – resize cards, reorder KPIs, format numbers, and customize colors for consistency. "By building one report everyone could use, we saved one to two analysts' worth of time annually with Zebra BI." — Shane Brinkmann, Business Analyst, W.L.
